email.subject: AI for Epstein Drangel - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jason,

Your work across trademark prosecution, copyright litigation, and anti-counterfeiting enforcement requires precision at every stage. We've built Lucio specifically for that, and it's resonating with IP-focused firms who need to compete without adding headcount.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform designed for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: accuracy, client trust, and real efficiency gains.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms in IP-heavy practice areas compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
